question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

Because I had to catch the train, and as we were short on time,** __I f____orget to pack my__ __toothbrush for our vacation__**.

options.text: I have forget to pack my toothbrush for our vacation
I forgot to pack my toothbrush for our vacation
I have forgot to pack my toothbrush for our vacation

solution:
The correct answer is** "I forgot to pack my toothbrush for our vacation."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb tense should be past simple (**"forgot"**) instead of simple present (**"forget"**).
 
• **"Forget"** is an irregular verb and its past simple form is** "forgot."**
 
• The sentence is in past tense (**"had to catch", "were short"**) so the verb tense should also be past simple to maintain the uniformity of the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Because I had to catch the train, and as we were short on time, **I forgot to pack my toothbrush for our vacation**__.*
